title: Green-synthesized Matricaria chamomilla silver nanoparticles enhance anticonvulsant and neuroprotective effects through GABAergic and antioxidant pathways in an acute seizure rat model
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,23078-23094
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01236A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yahya Alhamhoom, Rupesh Kumar M, Manjunath C, Kavitha K, Mohamed Rahamathulla, Hanan Albataineh, Syeda Ayesha Farhana, Mohammed Muqtader Ahmed, Thippeswamy Boreddy Shivanandappa, Ismail Pasha
Green-synthesized Matricaria chamomilla silver nanoparticles reduced PTZ-induced seizures and neuronal damage by enhancing GABAergic signaling and antioxidant defenses, outperforming the crude extract in anticonvulsant and neuroprotective effects.
